exposed_v8_development_summary.interpretation: Development evidence is descriptive and motivated this carryforward design; it is not a V8.1 validation result.

forbidden: treating 2018-2023 V8 evidence as fresh V8.1 validation
changing candidate family after this preregistration
changing frozen primary k after this preregistration
using sparse sensitivity variants to select a different parameter
opening 2024 rookie holdout outcomes before Phase 1 sparse-tail sensitivity passes
candidate refit after any 2024 holdout outcome is opened
new 2024 league search or holdout cohort additions
KTC/current market values as fit or validation targets
package-vote data as fit or validation targets

frozen_primary_candidate.family: global scalar times exact deployed R1-R6 PICK_BASE
frozen_primary_candidate.k_source: official V8 all-development diagnostic fit; frozen here without refit

primary_gates: 2024 H3 O2 equal-cell macro MAE improvement vs C0 >=5%
no individual round 2024 H3 O2 macro MAE regression vs C0 worse than 5%
combined R5-R6 2024 H3 O2 macro MAE relative regression vs C0 <=5%
2024 H3 O1 normalized 18-cell shape-error regression vs C0 <=2%
candidate parameter and 18-cell values unchanged since V8.1 Phase 0 freeze
future_2024_h3_primary_confirmation.scoring_not_before: 2026 NFL regular season is complete and Week 18 statistics are published

phase1_sparse_tail_sensitivity.diagnostic_refit_role: parameter-stability diagnostic only; diagnostic k values can never replace the frozen primary k
gates: all 7 diagnostic C1 refit k values must be within +/-10% relative of frozen primary k
all 7 sensitivity datasets must retain >=5% H3 O2 macro-MAE improvement for their fixed/refit C1 evaluation vs C0 under the variant's frozen weighting
all 7 sensitivity datasets must retain >=5% combined available R5-R6 H3 O2 macro-MAE improvement vs C0
no diagnostic refit may hit the inherited C1 k hard bounds
all generated C1 curves remain strictly positive and monotone non-increasing
required_runs: reproduce fixed primary candidate on full frozen V8 development corpus
diagnostic refit of same one-parameter C1 family after excluding all 2018 R6 occurrences
six diagnostic refits of the same C1 family, each leaving one frozen source-membership index out of all three 2018 R6 cells

variant_weighting.exclude_all_2018_r6: retain equal total weight for each draft class; within 2018 distribute that class weight equally across its 15 remaining cells; all other classes retain 18 equal cells; within cell preserve equal-league then equal-occurrence weighting
variant_weighting.leave_one_source_index_out: retain equal class and equal 18-cell weights; within each affected 2018 R6 cell renormalize equally across the five remaining frozen source leagues and their retained occurrences

primary_gates: 2024 H2 O2 equal-cell macro MAE improvement vs C0 >=5%
no individual round 2024 H2 O2 macro MAE regression vs C0 worse than 5%
combined R5-R6 2024 H2 O2 macro MAE relative regression vs C0 <=5%
2024 H2 O1 normalized 18-cell shape-error regression vs C0 <=2%
all frozen source/identity/retention gates remain satisfied
candidate parameter and 18-cell values unchanged since V8.1 Phase 0 freeze

rationale.postdevelopment_design_acknowledgement: V8.1 is intentionally informed by exposed V8 development evidence. It does not reinterpret V8 as a pass and does not claim the carryforward choice is unbiased development validation.
rationale.reason_for_new_study: The preregistered V8 individual-round gate was vetoed only by R6 for C1 while the pre-outcome V8 source-availability amendment had already identified 2018 R6 as source-sparse and required separate sparse-tail sensitivity before production.
rationale.why_c1: C1 is the one-parameter family, preserves the deployed 18-cell shape exactly under global scaling, passed 18/19 V8 gates, improved all six held-out classes, and did not saturate its preregistered hard bound.
rationale.why_not_c2: C2 failed both the individual-round gate and the frozen O1 shape-preservation gate.
rationale.why_not_c3: C3 passed the round gate but failed the frozen O1 shape-preservation and hard-bound gates.
rationale.why_not_c4: C4 failed O1 shape preservation, hard-bound diagnostics, and selected the preregistered alpha grid edge.
